objective: Review the non-executing parser-stub fixture contract before allowing an importable helper implementation.

review_decision.reason: The fixture definition is narrow and testable: it requires one accepted expanded native option case, explicit parser-stub rejection of unknown accelerators outside wrapper argparse choices, missing/non-positive shape rejection, compact --sim-accel-shape rejection as wrapper compatibility outside the native minimum, ordinary Verilator argument preservation including a warning flag, and a fixed parser-only handoff schema.
review_decision.weakest_point: This remains a contract review only. There is still no importable parser-stub helper, no Verilator source tree, and no parser patch; existing wrapper and shim CLIs still reject unknown accelerators through argparse choices. The implementation gate must make the validation observable without counting current argparse behavior as success.

required_next_gate.name: implement_verilator_native_option_parser_stub_fixture_gate

the accepted expanded native option case for --sim-accel sidecar-gpu --sim-accel-states 64 --sim-accel-steps 1

a structured handoff object with the 18 accepted fields and correctness_policy set to coverage_output_equivalence
